records.summary: Refreshed XRP Insights' daily same-wallet exchange-balance table and aligned it to the Binance incident timeline. Oct29 08:00 UTC balance snapshot predates the incident (20:05–20:09 UTC) and shows -41.2M XRP daily change. Oct30 08:00 UTC snapshot follows the incident and shows -207.3M XRP same-wallet daily change across the tracked exchange universe. The post-event aggregate is 88.8% of the 233.4619431M XRP incident transfer, a strong event-window lead but not a Binance-specific reconciliation. Binance-specific same-wallet change is -173.2M over 7d and -164.5M over 30d; the all-exchange 7d change is -234.9M and 30d is -146.1M. No per-exchange daily change, per-wallet history or five-source-wallet crosswalk is available. The same page attributes 59.5M XRP in two >99%-cold-labeled wallets to SBI VC Trade; this is exchange custody attribution, not SBI Group proprietary holdings. No market feature admitted and no directional forecast issued.
